_comment: Exercises bones.c savebones() -> remove_mon_from_bones() on a level holding Vlad the Impaler. A Tourist in debug mode forces a wizard-mode Vlad beside her, accepts the death he deals and saves bones. is_Vlad() sends him away through mon.c mongone(), whose steal.c mdrop_special_objs() calls zap.c obj_resists() for each item he carries before the hero's corpse monster is made.
